raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Square domain side length",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The square has no physical dimensions or stated length normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit square: L = 1.",
        "Square with L = 64, using unit element spacing for a 64-by-64 element reconstruction."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 has no dimension labels; Sec. 4.1 specifies image resolution rather than physical dimensions."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is specified for the two-dimensional example.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness, t = 1.",
        "Uniform plate thickness, t = 0.01L."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1 and Fig. 1 provide no thickness; Sec. 4.1 describes two-dimensional data."
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Left-edge nodes with horizontal displacement restrained",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The input panel shows five roller symbols spanning the left edge, while the output shows three over its lower portion. Their interpretation as discrete supports or an edge constraint is unstated.",
      "readings": [
        "Set u_x = 0 on the entire left edge; the symbols illustrate the constraint and surviving material contacts.",
        "Set u_x = 0 at five isolated left-edge nodes with y/L = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, following the input panel.",
        "Set u_x = 0 at three isolated left-edge nodes near y/L = 0.05, 0.29, 0.53, following the output panel."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 input and output panels; its legend specifies the restrained displacement direction, but Sec. 2.1 and the caption provide no support-node set."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Horizontal coordinate of the bottom-edge point load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The load is drawn approximately one-sixth of the width from the left, with a small position difference between panels. No coordinate or node index is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the load at (10L/64, 0).",
        "Apply the load at (11L/64, 0).",
        "Apply the load at (L/6, 0)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 upward arrows in both panels; Sec. 2.1 and the caption give no numerical load coordinate."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude of the single upward force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The arrow establishes direction but has no force value or normalization.",
      "readings": [
        "Upward unit nodal force in normalized units.",
        "Upward nodal force of 1000 N."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 1 load arrow; neither Sec. 2.1 nor Sec. 4.1 specifies a force magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical Young's modulus is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized Young's modulus E = 1.",
        "Young's modulus E = 210 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1, Fig. 1, and the dataset description in Sec. 4.1 give no elastic modulus."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The isotropic elastic Poisson's ratio is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio nu = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio nu = 0.25."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 2.1 and Sec. 4.1 provide no Poisson's ratio or complete constitutive matrix."
    }
  ]
}
